checkpoints.description: [1/3] Let the captain arm and stand down the docked trade broker

impact_assessment.why: /api/trade/automation stays context because the headless captain sets no thresholds, although engine, CLI and cockpit all expose the broker and long campaigns finish with 30k-70k credits parked at a station market; the mechanic therefore has no AI proof and its context reason contradicts the engine, which only needs a dock, a commodity and one threshold
impact_assessment.benefits: The broker is armed once after Act VI from the live market quote, executes a real automated trade on its cooldown, and is stood down so a 3-tick buy loop cannot crowd the hold; both switch directions reach the proof surface
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/trade/automation leaves CONTEXT_ACTIONS and is keyed by enabled in SIGNATURE_ROUTES (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: one armed window per campaign, persisted by the existing engine
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first policy tests for the quote, thresholds, gates and both signatures, 180-step gate measurement, 2,000-step campaigns on seeds 1/2/42, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Raise the suite's HTTP probe timeout so shared-host disk stalls stop flaking the gate

impact_assessment.why: Three consecutive full-suite gate runs failed on different tests with TimeoutError after two seconds (test_engineering GET, test_server scan/step/trade-pact, test_void_traversal emerge, agent campaign time/step), while the same tests pass alone and the same commit passed 1993 OK twice; every failure is a local HTTPConnection with timeout=2 against a server that fsyncs the full state on each POST, so a disk stall from another agent's work turns a healthy request into a gate failure
impact_assessment.benefits: The suite keeps every assertion but tolerates a stalled shared disk for up to ten seconds, so the gate reports code regressions instead of host contention
impact_assessment.risks: contract: test-only connection timeouts, no production or assertion change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: scripted replacement limited to HTTPConnection lines, compileall, full suite, 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Prove the away-mission abort path with a state-driven recall

impact_assessment.why: /api/away/recall stays context although the captain launches expeditions; its recall builder sits in the rotating tour and only runs after the 6-10 tick mission has already resolved, so an active mission is never present when it is reached and the abort route has no AI proof
impact_assessment.benefits: The captain remembers the step it launched from and recalls that mission on the next step, before a transit tick can finish it, so the recall route is exercised deterministically and the abort path is no longer unreachable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/away/recall joins SIGNATURE_ROUTES keyed by mission_id and may leave CONTEXT_ACTIONS after the gate measurement (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: one abort per campaign, the expedition reward is waived by design
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests for the launch step, one-step delay, one-shot and signature, 180-step gate measurement, 2,000-step campaigns on seeds 1/2/42, full suite and 5/5 gates
